contracts.arena: Allocate heads512, bank records44800, sound records102400 and backup102400 bytes on four-byte boundaries; zero only the three record arrays. Compose actual650280 persistent CRC initialization before filling all256 heads with-1.
contracts.banks: Reset bank/sound counts, but preserve and increment existing name-pool count. Copy seven raw words per built-in bank, replace local index and copied name pointer, then append0/0/0/-1 terminal header. Negative built-in count skips copies.
contracts.configuration: Copy path to810368 before calling the explicit mutable6520b0 service with original path,cursor,opaque arguments. Service sees initialized memory and may mutate it.
contracts.mask: After service, clear200-byte2947ca8 mask, snapshot current signed sound count and current record base, scan flags20000, sign-extend low15-bit ID, OR16-bit cells. Finally tail-call original memmove to copy all200bytes into2921760; Ghidra omits the three tail-call arguments.

native.method: Original6521b0 and650280/CRT zero/copy/string functions execute unchanged;6520b0 configuration/bank loading is the only mutable service. Whole declared memory regions compare byte-for-byte, with exact SHA256 and argument sequence at service entry and after completion.
